_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for the Rewards Finder, homepage table, and volume bracket pages.
_meta.sourcing_policy: On-site facts only. Fields not stated anywhere on the current site are null and listed in _flags. No numbers invented.
_flags: TIER THRESHOLDS: No casino publishes monthly-wager thresholds for VIP tiers anywhere on the site. The finder's tier logic (pick the tier a volume sustains) cannot be computed from on-site data for any casino.

TEST DATES: casinos.json stores withdrawal SPEED (e.g. '11 minutes') but no test DATE. Per the spec a Tested stamp needs a date; with no dated tests on-site, stamps cannot be shown under the on-site-only rule.
RAKEBACK RATES: Only Stake (5% Bronze to 15% Platinum, VIP only) and BC.Game have on-site rakeback figures. Most casinos have no stated rakeback rate.
CONFLICT - BC.Game rakeback: homepage says '20-24% advertised rakeback'; the BC.Game review implies wager-based rakeback 'starting at 0.5%'. These are inconsistent. Left null pending resolution.
PAYOUT MODEL TYPE (edge_based vs wager_based): not explicitly stated on-site for any casino; inferred only where a review describes the mechanic.
